entries.notes: Indexed to inflation, rounded to nearest $500. 2027 limit announced ~Nov-Dec 2026; rollover watch owns the refresh.
entries.source_note: CRA TFSA page; 2026 limit cross-checked across 7 sources 2026-09-28 (Wealthsimple, Fidelity, Silaws, Lifemoney, CIBC, Coast Capital, MoneyGenius).

entries.label: TFSA cumulative room by last year in band (eligible since 2009)
entries.notes: Shortcut rule: subtract cumulative at end of year before first eligible year.

entries.label: Maximum cumulative TFSA room at end of 2026 (eligible since 2009)
entries.notes: If eligible since 2009 and never contributed, room = $109,000 at end of 2026.

rejected.reason: $102,000 is the 2025 end-of-year total; a $103,500 aggregator figure was rejected in tfsa-vs-rrsp comparison research (CIBC's own 2026 figure: $109,000).

entries.label: TFSA eligibility
entries.notes: Newcomer rule: room begins in the year you became a Canadian resident (not 2009). CRA's example: David, resident since 2024, contributed $95,000 with $7,000 room = $88,000 excess taxed at 1%/month.
entries.source_note: CRA 'Before you contribute to a TFSA' (tfsa-basics-research, verified 2026-09-29).

entries.label: TFSA withdrawal room restoration
entries.notes: December 31 withdrawal -> room back Jan 1 next year. Re-depositing a withdrawal in the same year without other room = over-contribution. One room total across all TFSAs.
entries.value: Withdrawals restore room on January 1 of the following year, never the same year

entries.label: TFSA excess-contribution tax
entries.notes: Example (CRA-consistent): $2,000 over-contributed in June, removed in September = $20/mo x 4 months (June-September) = $80. Removing later in the same month as the over-contribution = only that one month.
entries.source_note: CRA 'If you owe tax on excess TFSA amounts' (verified 2026-09-29).

entries.label: TFSA excess-tax filing (RC243) deadline
entries.notes: File even if you withdrew the excess immediately; tax is charged for each month any excess remained.

entries.label: CRA My Account TFSA room update lag
entries.notes: CRA's own example: Moira checked Jan 1, saw $20,500, contributed $11,000 in February - owed tax on a $4,000 excess she didn't know existed.
entries.value: Banks report last year's transactions by end of February; CRA updates account in spring (2025 records by April 2026)

entries.label: TFSA formal transfer (no room consumed)
entries.value: Direct institution-to-institution transfer does not affect room; withdrawing then re-contributing does
